units.source_text: 葵姬生了这一场大病之后，身体自然十分虚弱，大家很担心，认为不可疏忽。

en.t: After Lady Aoi had suffered this serious illness, her body was naturally very weak, and everyone was worried and felt that no carelessness could be allowed.

units.source_text: 源氏公子也认为理应如此，守着病人，足不出户。

en.t: Prince Genji also thought this was only proper, so he stayed by the patient and did not leave the house.

units.source_text: 葵姬身上还很不舒服，不能像平日那样和源氏公子晤谈。

en.t: Lady Aoi was still feeling very unwell and could not converse with Prince Genji as she usually did.

units.source_text: 新生的婴儿相貌异常端正，源氏公子对他的宝爱，当非寻常可比。

en.t: The newborn baby had remarkably handsome features, and Prince Genji's cherished love for him was beyond ordinary comparison.

units.source_text: 左大臣觉得万事如意称心，十分欢喜。

en.t: The Minister of the Left felt that everything had turned out just as he wished, and he was extremely pleased.

units.source_text: 只是葵姬身体尚未痊愈，不免担心。

en.t: Only Lady Aoi's body had still not recovered, so there was inevitably some worry.

units.source_text: 但念此次病势如此沉重，当然不会立刻复健。

en.t: But considering how grave this illness had been, it was only natural that she would not recover her strength at once.
For that reason, they were not especially anxious.
